payload.claim: The spec's 'Out of scope' section promises that a status outside the closed set makes `build` raise `ViewGraphError`, the same path an invalid severity takes through pyshacl validation. But `gate_results.status` has no DB CHECK constraint (`saffron/ledger.py:170-183`) and `record_gate_result` writes it unvalidated (`:1828-1848`), so nothing stops a row with an unexpected status reaching this code. Line 277 looks the value up with a bare `_STATUS_OUTCOME[gate_row['status']]`, so such a row raises an unhandled `KeyError` before any triple or validation happens, not the documented `ViewGraphError`. Severity's equivalent path (`factory[finding_row['severity']]`, line 321) has no such lookup and does reach shacl validation correctly, so the two closed-set checks the spec treats as parallel are not actually implemented the same way. No test exercises a non-closed-set status, so this gap is invisible to the suite.
